description: Robin adds an item. The new Tasks row carries a t-shirt size in the size column, chosen from the item as written; the existing rows keep theirs; the Log gains a line.
prompt: New item for the tracker: rewrite the upload endpoint's README — the auth section, the three curl examples, and the error table — mine, no rush.

graders.name: reads the tracker-rows skill before the first tracker Edit/Write
graders.rule: `size` is your judgement of the item as written, `S`, `M`, `L` or `XL`, made when you write the task and remade when the item changes: `S` is one edit, one file, one fact to check; `M` is one item a session finishes in a sitting, a few files, one suite run; `L` is a plan with bullets, several files, its own pull request; `XL` is a task that spawns other tasks or spans sessions.

graders.name: new row carries a size in the size column
Log times are this move's clock reads
